name: Moeller Attack — Main Line
description: White sacrifices a piece with 7.Nc3 and launches a ferocious attack. The sharpest line in the Giuoco Piano — high-stakes chess where precise play decides everything.

lines.name: Moeller Attack (7.Nc3)
lines.description: White plays 7.Nc3 to block the check and invite Nxe4, then castles and sacrifices the knight with d5. The d5-pawn cramps Black while White doubles on the e-file, winning back material with interest.
